title: Jazzy American Lard Hash
description: Funky, molten, brunch-mood American dish featuring lard, al-dente-finish, vegetarian-friendly and perfect for a lazy Sunday.
instructions: Heat the lard in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes, bell peppers, and minced garlic. Cook for an additional 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the crushed hash browns, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the hash browns are golden brown and the mixture is heated through.
Use a spatula to shape the mixture into a circle or square shape.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the bottom is crispy and golden brown.
Flip the hash over and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the other side is crispy and golden brown.
Garnish with chopped fresh chives and serve immediately.
